inputs.causal_hypothesis: Grid-interconnection delays can shift some AI-data-centre power demand toward Bloom Energy on-site fuel cells, subject to fuel availability, emissions policy, financing, concentration, manufacturing execution, competing generation, and valuation.
inputs.research_focus: Validate identity, AI-data-centre order materiality, customer concentration, fuel and carbon economics, financing, manufacturing capacity, cash conversion, valuation, catalysts, and invalidation.

objective: Research Bloom Energy as a bounded on-site power substitute for grid-constrained AI data centres.
